claims: The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs begin the weekend of April 18-19.
The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs feature a 16-team, four-round best-of-seven format.
The top three teams per division plus two wild cards per conference qualify for the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs.
The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs start date is April 18-19, 2026.
The 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs format is 16 teams (8 per conference), four rounds, best-of-seven series.
2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs qualification is top 3 teams in each division + 2 wild cards per conference.
First round of 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs matches division winners against wild cards.
First round of 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Playoffs matches 2nd/3rd place teams within divisions.
Conference winners meet in the Stanley Cup Final.
Carolina Hurricanes have clinched a playoff spot as of April 2.
Colorado Avalanche have clinched a playoff spot as of April 2.

Toronto Maple Leafs are eliminated from the playoffs.
General public tickets for the playoffs go on sale April 9.
Current projected Eastern Conference matchups if playoffs started today are BUF vs. BOS, TBL vs. MTL, CAR vs. CBJ, PIT vs. NYI.
Current projected Western Conference matchups if playoffs started today are COL vs. NSH, DAL vs. MIN, ANA vs. UTA, EDM vs. VGK.
The playoffs determine the champion of the National Hockey League (NHL).
